identity_rule: The pair (definition_id, version) is unique. Successor admission preserves predecessor bytes and admission history; the explicit current_lookup selects the version used by new work. A successor-of relation does not withdraw or supersede its predecessor.
claim_ceiling: Conditional prospective authored postimage only: 189 previously admitted versions plus two intended admitted entries IF the exact qualified owner Decision and applicable application later occur. New authority_state=admitted values describe the requested future postimage, not captured standing or actual admission. Root status remains candidate-unadmitted and authority_effect none. Actual pending standing remains in the separate candidate delta. No live registry replacement, global alias registration or runtime effect is performed.
